title: PAR-20/7G.3 ACAD_LAYOUT NOD root alias refusal

finding.coverageGap: The generated ASCII/Binary layout graph route did not exercise a duplicate canonical root or a second NOD key targeting the same ACAD_LAYOUT dictionary.
finding.scope: ACAD_LAYOUT NOD-root uniqueness and alias refusal only.

implementation: Applied validateNamedObjectRootForExport() before layout-specific reciprocal graph validation.

Both invalid graphs must preserve a seeded destination; the existing multi-layout/version output and readback controls cover valid graph emission.
